metadata.title: fix(security): team-scoped tokens now include public resources in listings
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- **Fix team-scoped token visibility**: API tokens with `teams: ["team-id"]` were silently excluding all public resources from list endpoints, violating the documented "Team + Public" security model. Removed `team_id = team_id or token_team_id` auto-narrowing from all six list endpoints (servers, gateways, tools, resources, prompts, A2A agents) — the `token_teams` array already handles correct visibility scoping via `_apply_visibility_filter`.
- **Fix token creation test race condition**: The Playwright `test_create_and_revoke_token` test timed out because the JS form submit handler is attached via a 300ms debounced `setTimeout` in `showTab()`. Added a wait for `data-setup` attribute before interacting with the form.

## Details

### Security fix (`mcpgateway/main.py`)

When `request.state.team_id` was set (single-team API tokens), the list endpoints auto-narrowed via:
```python
team_id = team_id or token_team_id
```
This forced `_apply_visibility_filter` into the `if team_id:` branch, which scopes results strictly to `model.team_id == team_id` — excluding public resources where `team_id IS NULL`.

The `token_teams` list passed to each service already correctly handles the global listing path:
```python
access_conditions = [model_cls.visibility == "public"]  # always included
if token_teams:
    access_conditions.append(model_cls.team_id.in_(token_teams) & model_cls.visibility.in_(["team", "public"]))
```

The explicit `?team_id=` query param mismatch guard is preserved for all endpoints.

### Test fix (`tests/playwright/pages/components/sidebar_component.py`)

Added `wait_for_selector('#create-token-form[data-setup="true"]')` in `click_tokens_tab()` to wait for the JS submit handler before the test interacts with the form.

## Verification

- 12,846 unit tests pass (0 failures)
- All 3 previously-failing Playwright tests now pass
- Confirmed via direct API testing that team-scoped tokens see both public and team servers

commits.message:
fix(security): team-scoped tokens now include public resources in listings

Team-scoped API tokens (teams: ["team-id"]) were only returning resources
belonging to their team, silently excluding all public resources. This
violated the documented security model where team-scoped tokens should see
"Team + Public" resources.

Root cause: all six list endpoints (servers, gateways, tools, resources,
prompts, A2A agents) contained `team_id = team_id or token_team_id` which
auto-narrowed listings to the token's single team when no explicit
?team_id= query param was provided. This forced _apply_visibility_filter
into the "specific team" branch, which requires team_id match — excluding
public resources with team_id IS NULL.

Fix: remove the auto-narrowing from list endpoints. The token_teams array
already passed to each service correctly handles visibility scoping via the
global listing branch (public OR team-member OR owner conditions). The
team_id mismatch guard for explicit query params is preserved.

Also fixes a Playwright test race condition where the token creation form
submitted as a plain HTML GET instead of a JS fetch POST, because the
submit handler (attached via a 300ms debounced setTimeout in showTab) had
not yet fired when the test clicked submit.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
test(security): add differential tests for team-scoped list visibility fix

Add 8 endpoint-level regression tests that verify list endpoints do not
auto-narrow team_id from token state. Uses an ASGI middleware injector to
simulate team-scoped request.state without running full auth middleware.

Tests cover all 6 affected list endpoints (servers, tools, resources,
prompts, gateways, a2a-agents) plus explicit team_id passthrough and
team_id mismatch 403 scenarios.

Closes #3332

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message: fix(ui): escape closing tags in JS string to fix htmlhint tag-pair warnings The team selector retry button's innerHTML assignment contained literal closing tags inside a JavaScript string within an Alpine.js x-data attribute. htmlhint parsed these as real HTML closing tags, which threw off tag matching for the rest of the file (header, div). Use <\/button><\/div> escaping to prevent the HTML parser from seeing them as structural closing tags. Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti
